prompt_url: Enter video or playlist URL (s = settings, a = archive tools, blank = exit):
prompt_mode: What do you want to download?
prompt_playlist: This looks like a playlist. Download entire playlist or just this video?
prompt_exit_error: An error occurred. Do you want to exit? (Y/N):
profile_compatibility: Compatibility (MP4 with H.264 + AAC; re-encoded only where needed)
error_ytdlp_not_found: yt-dlp not found. Please run the installer first.
error_ffmpeg_not_found: ffmpeg not found. Please run the installer first.
error_invalid_url: Invalid URL. Please enter a valid video or playlist URL.
error_url_invalid_input: That does not look like a usable link. Enter a full http:// or https:// URL.
error_network: Network error. Please check your connection.
error_region_blocked: This video is not available in your region.
error_age_restricted: This video is age-restricted. Sign in required.
error_members_only: This video is for channel members only.
error_copyright: This video has been removed due to copyright.
config_read_warning: WARNING: config.json could not be read; continuing with the defaults.
error_check_logs: Unexpected error. Check logs if available.
info_archive_waits_value: {requests}s between requests, {low}-{high}s between videos, {subtitles}s before subtitles
stage1_desc: MP4 without re-encoding when H.264 + AAC is available...
stage2_desc: download the remaining items and make them H.264 + AAC in MP4 (converted only where needed)...
archive_desc: Video (up to your resolution limit, MKV), description, info JSON, thumbnail and subtitles. Waiting between requests to avoid rate limits...
archive_channel_id_fallback: Could not look up the channel id; using "{id}" from the URL for the archive file. Use the same URL to resume.
ban_detected_title: YouTube is temporarily blocking requests - download stopped.
ban_detected_detail: It answered with HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) or "Sign in to confirm you're not a bot". Sending more requests now would only extend the block.
ban_retry_hint: Wait a few hours, then enter the same URL again: the download resumes where it left off.
playlist_all_archived: All playlist items appear archived (no skips).
settings_keep_hint: Leave blank to keep the current value.
settings_clear_hint: Leave blank to keep the current value, or enter {clear} to clear it.
settings_invalid_number: Enter a whole number between {min} and {max}.
settings_invalid_seconds: Enter a number of seconds between 0 and {max} (for example 1.5).
settings_dir_error: That folder could not be created: {error}
settings_sleep_adjusted: The maximum wait was raised to match the minimum.
settings_archive_sleep_subtitles: Archive: wait before each subtitle download (seconds)
config_videos_prompt: Enter folder path for VIDEOS (blank = default):
config_music_prompt: Enter folder path for MUSIC (blank = default):
config_edit_hint: To change these later, type s at the URL prompt to open the settings, or edit config.json at: {path}
skip_reason_format: Requested format not available (format list missing / JS challenge)
skip_reason_js_challenge: YouTube JS challenge or signature extraction issue
skip_reason_postprocess: Formats available; download or post-processing failed (audio/ffmpeg/thumbnail/metadata)
skip_reason_json_parse: Could not parse JSON (format detection failed)
command_failed: Command failed unexpectedly. See the log for details.
warn_ffmpeg_mp3: MP3 mode may fail to convert audio.
warn_ffmpeg_mp4: MP4 mode may fail to merge/recode and attach thumbnails.
warn_ffmpeg_fix: Fix: run install.ps1 or install ffmpeg and add it to PATH.
warn_deno_detail: Some videos may fail if yt-dlp cannot solve JS challenges.
warn_impersonation_missing: yt-dlp cannot impersonate a browser (the curl_cffi package is missing).
warn_impersonation_detail: YouTube rejects subtitle downloads without it (HTTP 429), so archive mode will stop at the first subtitle.
warn_impersonation_fix: Fix: restart with Run.bat / run.sh (installs it automatically), or: pip install "yt-dlp[default,curl-cffi]"
stage1_partial: Stage 1 could not cover every item; Stage 2 will handle the rest.
error_log_hint: For technical details, check the log file:
error_log_unreadable: Could not analyze the error log.
error_download_generic: An unexpected error occurred during the download.
error_forbidden: Access denied (HTTP 403). The site might be blocking the downloader.
error_unsupported_url: This URL format is not supported.
playlist_fetch_failed: Could not fetch playlist entries; the skip report may be incomplete.
playlist_fetch_failed_log: Failed to fetch playlist entries (skip report may be partial)
preflight_listing_warning: Reading a large channel or playlist can take several minutes: about 30 videos are read per page.
preflight_listing_warning_wait: Each page also waits {seconds} s between requests.
preflight_speed_measured: Connection speed to a public test server: about {mbps} Mbit/s. YouTube's speed may differ, so the times below are rough.
preflight_speed_unknown: Connection speed could not be measured; download time is not estimated.
estimate_title: Estimated size (high-side estimate: duration x typical bit rate)
estimate_summary: {count} videos to download, {archived} already in the archive, {assumed} with an assumed duration
estimate_unavailable: Size could not be calculated; the download continues.
estimate_nothing_new: Every video in this list is already in the archive; nothing new to download.
estimate_free_unknown: Free disk space could not be measured; skipping the space check.
estimate_compat_note: The compatibility profile is limited to 1080p (H.264).
disk_low_warning: Not enough free space: about {needed} needed, {free} free.
disk_low_prompt: What do you want to do?
disk_low_cancelled: Cancelled: not enough free disk space.
prompt_resolution_save: Use this choice only for this download, or make it the default?
resolution_save_failed: Could not save the default ({error}). Continuing with your choice.
outcome_partial: Finished with problems: some items were not downloaded.
outcome_failed: Nothing was downloaded: every item failed.
outcome_missing_items: {count} recorded as done but the file is missing: {ids}
outcome_failed_unknown: {count} failed (see the log for the reason)
skip_reason_blocked: YouTube is blocking requests (bot check); probing stopped
config_corrupt_kept: The unreadable file was kept as {name}.
config_folder_invalid: config.json: '{field}' is not a usable folder path; you will be asked for it again.
config_migrated: config.json was updated to the current format ({count} change(s)); the old file is kept as a .bak copy on the next save.
settings_issue_invalid: Setting '{field}' is not usable ({problem}); using {fallback} instead.
settings_save_failed: Could not save the settings ({error}); nothing was changed.
settings_external_config: Read my own yt-dlp config files
settings_external_config_hint: Off (recommended): the app's settings alone decide what yt-dlp does. On: yt-dlp also reads its config files (yt-dlp.conf), which can override or break the choices made here.
settings_speed_test_hint: Before a playlist download a short test (about 10 MB, at most a few seconds) measures your connection to turn the size estimate into a time estimate. It talks to speed.cloudflare.com, not YouTube.
audio_desc: Downloading the best audio and converting it to {format}...
notice_non_youtube: This is not a YouTube address. It is passed to yt-dlp as a single item; playlist and channel handling, the size estimate and channel archives are for YouTube only.
archive_records_note: Items already in the archive are skipped whatever the target folder, resolution or audio format is now. To download them again or to repair missing files, use the archive tools (type a at the URL prompt).
preflight_speed_off: The speed test is off (change it in the settings); download time is not estimated.
estimate_unlimited_note: "Unlimited" is estimated for up to 8K (4320p) at a typical top bit rate; the real size depends on the formats each video actually offers, so it is only an estimate.
archive_wait_estimate: Waits between videos alone: at least {minimum}, about {expected} on average ({count} videos, {low}-{high} s each); download time is not included.
audit_none: No download archives were found in {folder}.
audit_archive_line: {name}: {total} records: {present} present, {missing} missing, {unverified} cannot be checked
audit_unverified_note: "Cannot be checked": the record has no saved file path and no file or folder name holds its id (typical for downloads made before names carried the id). Nothing is repaired on a guess.
audit_repair_hint: To download the missing ones again: --repair shows what would change, --repair --apply does it (after a backup).
audit_apply_hint: Run the same command with --apply to make this change; the archive is backed up first.
audit_restore_hint: To undo, copy the backup over the archive file.
audit_unknown_archive: There is no archive named {name} in {folder}.
audit_menu_report: Check the archives against the files (changes nothing)
audit_menu_repair: Download missing files again (removes their records; asks first)
audit_menu_forget_all: Download one archive's items again (removes all its records; asks first)
audit_confirm: Make this change? A backup of the archive is made first.
audit_confirm_no: No, leave everything as it is
